items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: organizing Fletcher Henderson's group for Ethel Waters... we traveled on the road with Ethel Waters... we was with Fletcher

ctx.x: Oh, let me tell you -- you see something we've omitted in '22, latter part -- or the middle of '22 -- organizing Fletcher Henderson's group for Ethel Waters. That was the next blues singer after Mamie.
Right, I want to touch up on a lot of things as we go along.
